Hi Jared / Priya —

Great to meet on Tuesday — thanks for walking through the evaluation priorities. As discussed, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan that maps the key milestones, owners, and suggested target dates so we can keep momentum. Quick recap and asks below:

- Objective: Proof-of-concept focused on latency-sensitive user flows (checkout pipeline).
- Proposed timeline: kickoff prep (week of Dec 13), internal POC (2 weeks), review + decision (week of Jan 4).
- Asks: Please confirm (1) the internal owner for the evaluation, (2) any constraints on the Dec timeline, and (3) stakeholders who need read access to the MAP.

Next steps I can take immediately: update the MAP with the owners/dates you confirm, schedule the technical kickoff, and reserve a dedicated test slot on Redwood Dedicated for the POC. If the Dec 13 kickoff is tight for you, flag a preferred alternate window.

Attachment: [redwood-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 324 KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.
